gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-hedvig-l: Loud and level: Love Ya Like A Sister holds a ruler-straight line weight throughout. And Hedvig Letters Sans, with its wide-mouthed c and tall small letters, keeps the page easy to move through.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-heebo: Heebo gives Love Ya Like A Sister a tall band of sans-serif text, its curves stopping short instead of closing. Heebo carries a long paragraph without pulling focus from the bold heading.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-hind-mad: Bold, with ascenders barely clearing the x-height, Love Ya Like A Sister sets a level, outward-flaring tone. Hind Madurai reads smoothly across paragraphs, its sans-serif strokes all cut from one ribbon.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-hind-sil: Expressive and low-slung, Love Ya Like A Sister flares its terminals outward while keeping ascenders barely above the x-height. Hind Siliguri hums beneath it with gapped rounds and a flat gray weight, letting the heading talk.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-karla: Loud, low and level, Love Ya Like A Sister holds one pen width. What stands out most is Karla, whose gaping c and stocky, tall middle band give the body text a sturdy, open feel.

gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-martel-s: Constant stroke weight, no sparkle: that is Love Ya Like A Sister. Martel Sans sits beneath with generous curve openings and a high mean line, giving the heading plenty of room to speak.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-michroma: Michroma reads wide and tall-bodied, every letter given generous room on both sides. And Love Ya Like A Sister brings pen-like boldness at constant weight where Michroma brings open, daylit curves.
